title: Blast-radius configuration
description: What the blast-radius machinery runs and scans for a repository. `source: project` is the repository's own .dag/ configuration; `source: run` is a per-run configuration recorded in the run directory. regression_commands[] are run at the run's base and at its tip and compared (the integration record's differential[]); a repository with none states why in regression_none_reason - exactly one of the two, so an empty command list is never silently 'no regressions'. coupling_rules[] raise a coupling obligation when a changed path matches when_paths[]; the rule is satisfied by running `require.command` or by the same change set touching one of `require.touch_any[]` (exactly one form per rule). censuses[] count a defect class at base and tip; must_not_increase:true makes any added item a failure (gross additions, never the net). test_surfaces[] name where tests live so test weakening can be detected. scan_excludes[] are path globs the impact scanner skips. Closed objects throughout.

compare.description: What is compared between the base and tip runs, e.g. exit, exit+stdout.

oneOf.description: Regression commands are declared (non-empty) and no none-reason is given.
No regression commands: the reason is stated and any regression_commands list is empty.
